platform: KEXP Global Digital Music Submission Email Route
manual_review_reason: KEXP accepts singles, albums and EPs through the publicly listed Music Department mailbox md@kexp.org. The email must include both a streaming link and a WAV download link, with no attachments, plus artist identity and pronouns, release title, label where applicable, phonetic spellings where needed, focus tracks, release dates, clean edits for FCC-restricted content, lyrics, credits, a bio or one-sheet and relevant Pacific Northwest or Bay Area shows. A human must select a rights-cleared MarcsMusic release, review content and metadata, prepare the required links and supporting information, and send manually.

platform: WXPN 88.5 Digital EPK Music Submission Route
manual_review_reason: WXPN's official Contact page authorizes unsolicited airplay submissions by email to the Music Director and requires an EPK containing a link to digitally download the music. The destination is presented through a first-party Email Music Director action but was not exposed in plaintext in the passive page representation, so it was not decoded or guessed. The separate Local Show route requires local relevance and was not queued for MarcsMusic. A human must reopen the official page, use only the current Music Director action, confirm international and catalogue fit, prepare a concise EPK and reliable download link, and send manually.
